evidence.observation: Flow dropped abruptly from ~100 to ~55 sccm at k=96 despite setpoint 100, lasting ~240 s until recovering at k=144-147
Tube pressure fell in lockstep from ~3.05 to ~2.60 Torr and returned to ~3.04 when flow recovered, consistent with a genuine flow deficit rather than a sensor fault
Temperature held at setpoint and heater power nominal throughout; cooldown proceeding normally with Ar 200 sccm
